analogy.rationale: Antioxidants lack a single annotated target and generally blunt rather than activate transcriptional programs, so responses are expected to be weak; oxidative stress inducers act on the opposing redox axis and chelating agents overlap in metal/redox chemistry, while anti-inflammatory and NFkB/sterol pathways share downstream stress-response modules.
